newsitem.title: RUSSIA: IBCA, S&P to rate Russia's St Petersburg by March.
newsitem.headline: IBCA, S&P to rate Russia's St Petersburg by March.

text.p: IBCA and Standard & Poor's will finish work necessary to assign ratings to the northern European Russian city of St Petersburg by the end of March, a city Finance Committee spokeswoman said on Friday.
She said the two rating agencies had visited St Petersburg, which is preparing to issue Eurobonds, this week to prepare rating books.
St Petersburg has received preliminary approval from the central bank for the Eurobonds, which the city plans to use to raise up to $300 million with a maturity between two and five years, she said.
"(We received) a preliminary letter, which approves (an) Eurobond issue by the city in principle," she said. "The prospectus is not yet registered."
